"""Exact NRS 484B.503 Native passenger-curb acquisition entrypoint."""

import runpy


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runpy.run_module("native.native_capture", run_name="__main__")

"""Source-shaped exact passenger curb loading scene requests.

These authored inputs require Native map and actor readback before use. A sign
in an authored map does not establish regulatory authority or expeditiousness.
"""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CASES = {"condition_a": True, "condition_b": False,
         "outside_hours_loading": True, "outside_hours_no_transfer": False,
         "brief_stop_no_transfer": False, "extended_park_no_transfer": False}
CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
RATE_HZ = 20
FRAMES = 600


def road_xml():
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4", name="C149498-passenger-curb",
                  version="1", north="25", south="-25", east="90", west="-90",
                  vendor="full-train-worker")
    road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id="149498", name="one_way_loading_road",
                         length="160", junction="-1")
    ET.SubElement(road, "link")
    geometry = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "planView"), "geometry",
                             s="0", x="-80", y="0", hdg="0", length="160")
    ET.SubElement(geometry, "line")
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile"), "elevation",
                  s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
    ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
    for side, lane_id, kind in (("left", 1, "none"), ("center", 0, "none"),
                                ("right", -1, "driving")):
        lane = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, side), "lane", id=str(lane_id),
                             type=kind, level="false")
        if lane_id:
            ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    objects = ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
    ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="passenger-zone-curb-149498", s="55", t="-3.7",
                  name="marked_passenger_curb_loading_zone", type="curb", orientation="none",
                  zOffset="0", length="24", width="0.2", height="0.15", hdg="0",
                  pitch="0", roll="0")
    signals = ET.SubElement(road, "signals")
    ET.SubElement(signals, "signal", id="passenger-loading-sign-149498", s="55",
                  t="-4.1", name="PASSENGER LOADING 08:00-18:00 America/Los_Angeles",
                  dynamic="no", orientation="+", zOffset="0", country="US",
                  type="passenger-loading", subtype="0", value="0", unit="",
                  height="0.8", width="0.8")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")


def request(slug):
    if slug not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact loading case")
    outside_hours = slug.startswith("outside_hours")
    brief = slug == "brief_stop_no_transfer"
    extended = slug == "extended_park_no_transfer"
    return {
        "format": "worker-authored-passenger-curb-request",
        "case": slug, "road_opendrive": road_xml(),
        "zone": {"kind": "passenger_curb_loading", "object_id": "passenger-zone-curb-149498",
                 "sign_id": "passenger-loading-sign-149498", "curb_start_x_m": -25,
                 "curb_end_x_m": -1, "time_zone": "America/Los_Angeles",
                 "hours_start": "08:00", "hours_end": "18:00",
                 "civil_timestamp_start": "2026-11-23T19:00:00-08:00" if outside_hours else "2026-11-23T10:00:00-08:00",
                 "legal_authority": "unverified_original_source"},
        "ego": {"blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "start_xyz": [-35, -1.75, 0.5],
                "heading_deg": 0, "target_halt_center_x_m": -12, "target_speed_mps": 5.0},
        "passenger": {"blueprint_filter": "walker.pedestrian.*",
                      "start_xyz": [-10, -5.5, 0.5],
                      "target_door_xyz": [-12, -3.2, 0.5],
                      "cross_doorway_requested": CASES[slug]},
        "controller": {"policy": "approach_halt_door_cycle_resume",
                       "action_request": "brief_stop" if brief else ("extended_park" if extended else "standing_episode"),
                       "halt_request_frame": 90,
                       "door_open_request_frame": None if (brief or extended) else 140,
                       "door_close_request_frame": None if (brief or extended) else 420,
                       "resume_request_frame": 150 if brief else (590 if extended else 480),
                       "passenger_walk_request_frame": 170,
                       "transfer_engineering_target_frame": 260},
        "cameras": [
            {"name": "overview", "xyz": [-12, -17, 18], "pitch": -42, "yaw": 40,
             "size": [1920, 1080], "pose_strategy": "fixed curb and full vehicle overview"},
            {"name": "approach", "xyz": [-2, -11, 8], "pitch": -24, "yaw": 160,
             "size": [1280, 720], "pose_strategy": "fixed approach and sign view"},
            {"name": "reference_corner", "xyz": [-12, -9, 6], "pitch": -24, "yaw": 70,
             "size": [1280, 720], "pose_strategy": "fixed door, curb and passenger view"},
            {"name": "driver_reference", "xyz": [1, 0, 2], "pitch": -8, "yaw": 0,
             "attach_to_ego": True, "size": [1280, 720],
             "pose_strategy": "ego attached driver view"}],
        "rate_hz": RATE_HZ, "duration_s": 30, "planned_frames": FRAMES,
        "original_native_observed": False, "physical_transfer_claimed": False,
        "expeditiousness_conclusion": None,
    }


def validate(scene):
    if scene.get("case") not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact loading case")
    root = ET.fromstring(scene["road_opendrive"])
    roads = root.findall("road")
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE" or len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get("id") != "149498":
        raise ValueError("one-way loading road missing")
    road = roads[0]
    objects = road.findall("objects/object")
    signs = road.findall("signals/signal")
    if len(objects) != 1 or objects[0].get("id") != scene["zone"]["object_id"]:
        raise ValueError("marked passenger curb missing")
    if len(signs) != 1 or signs[0].get("id") != scene["zone"]["sign_id"]:
        raise ValueError("effective-hours sign missing")
    if not all(x in signs[0].get("name", "") for x in ("08:00", "18:00", "America/Los_Angeles")):
        raise ValueError("sign schedule differs")
    if scene["zone"]["legal_authority"] != "unverified_original_source":
        raise ValueError("sign authority cannot be presumed")
    if scene["passenger"]["cross_doorway_requested"] is not CASES[scene["case"]]:
        raise ValueError("comparison passenger request differs")
    expected_civil = "19:00:00" if scene["case"].startswith("outside_hours") else "10:00:00"
    if expected_civil not in scene["zone"]["civil_timestamp_start"]:
        raise ValueError("case signed-hours contrast differs")
    action = scene["controller"].get("action_request")
    resume = scene["controller"].get("resume_request_frame")
    expected = ("brief_stop", 150) if scene["case"] == "brief_stop_no_transfer" else (
        ("extended_park", 590) if scene["case"] == "extended_park_no_transfer" else
        ("standing_episode", 480))
    if (action, resume) != expected:
        raise ValueError("case action and duration request differ")
    door_frames = (scene["controller"].get("door_open_request_frame"),
                   scene["controller"].get("door_close_request_frame"))
    if door_frames != ((None, None) if scene["case"] in
                       {"brief_stop_no_transfer", "extended_park_no_transfer"} else (140, 420)):
        raise ValueError("case door policy differs")
    if tuple(sorted(c["name"] for c in scene["cameras"])) != tuple(sorted(CAMERAS)):
        raise ValueError("four-camera plan missing")
    if any(tuple(c["size"]) != ((1920, 1080) if c["name"] == "overview" else (1280, 720))
           or not c.get("pose_strategy") for c in scene["cameras"]):
        raise ValueError("camera size or pose plan missing")
    if scene["rate_hz"] != RATE_HZ or scene["planned_frames"] != FRAMES or scene["duration_s"] != 30:
        raise ValueError("exact 20 Hz capture plan differs")
    if scene["physical_transfer_claimed"] or scene["original_native_observed"]:
        raise ValueError("authored request cannot claim original observation")
    return {"case": scene["case"], "road_count": 1, "camera_count": 4,
            "planned_frames": FRAMES, "source_request_checked": True,
            "original_native_observed": False}

"""Lazy CARLA construction with original curb/sign readback and actor ownership."""

from contextlib import contextmanager
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from .loading_scene import CAMERAS, validate


def transform(carla, xyz, pitch=0, yaw=0):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=0))


def checked_map(world, scene):
    source = world.get_map().to_opendrive()
    roads = {road.get("id"): road for road in ET.fromstring(source).findall("road")}
    road = roads.get("149498")
    if road is None or len(roads) != 1:
        raise ValueError("original one-way loading road differs")
    curb = road.find("objects/object")
    sign = road.find("signals/signal")
    if curb is None or curb.get("id") != scene["zone"]["object_id"] or curb.get("type") != "curb":
        raise ValueError("original marked passenger curb differs")
    if sign is None or sign.get("id") != scene["zone"]["sign_id"]:
        raise ValueError("original loading-zone sign differs")
    if not all(value in sign.get("name", "") for value in
               (scene["zone"]["hours_start"], scene["zone"]["hours_end"],
                scene["zone"]["time_zone"])):
        raise ValueError("original sign schedule differs")
    return source


@contextmanager
def constructed_scene(client, carla, scene):
    """Create scene actors and cameras; restore timing and destroy owned actors."""
    validate(scene)
    world = client.generate_opendrive_world(scene["road_opendrive"])
    source = checked_map(world, scene)
    settings = world.get_settings()
    old_sync = settings.synchronous_mode
    old_delta = settings.fixed_delta_seconds
    owned = []
    try:
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / scene["rate_hz"]
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        readback = world.get_settings()
        if not readback.synchronous_mode or abs(readback.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("original 20 Hz timing readback differs")
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(scene["ego"]["blueprint"]),
                                    transform(carla, scene["ego"]["start_xyz"],
                                              yaw=scene["ego"]["heading_deg"]))
        if ego is None:
            raise RuntimeError("original loading vehicle spawn failed")
        owned.append(ego)
        walkers = library.filter(scene["passenger"]["blueprint_filter"])
        if not walkers:
            raise RuntimeError("original passenger blueprint unavailable")
        passenger = world.try_spawn_actor(walkers[0],
                                          transform(carla, scene["passenger"]["start_xyz"]))
        if passenger is None:
            raise RuntimeError("original passenger spawn failed")
        owned.append(passenger)
        cameras = {}
        for spec in scene["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(spec["size"][0]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(spec["size"][1]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("fov", "80")
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(
                blueprint, transform(carla, spec["xyz"], pitch=spec["pitch"], yaw=spec["yaw"]),
                attach_to=ego if spec.get("attach_to_ego") else None)
            if sensor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("original loading camera spawn failed: " + spec["name"])
            owned.append(sensor)
            cameras[spec["name"]] = sensor
        if set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("four original camera actors missing")
        yield {"world": world, "ego": ego, "passenger": passenger, "cameras": cameras,
               "map_opendrive": checked_map(world, scene),
               "occupant_count_observed": False,
               "regulatory_authority_observed": False}
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            actor.destroy()
        settings.synchronous_mode = old_sync
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = old_delta
        world.apply_settings(settings)

"""Original-frame acquisition for exact passenger-loading and no-transfer cases."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess

from .loading_scene import CAMERAS, CASES, FRAMES, RATE_HZ, request, validate
from .native_construction import constructed_scene

AID = "training__C149498__NRS-484B-503__motor_vehicle_driver"


def case_id(slug):
    if slug not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact loading case")
    suffix = "selected_bae4893e__" + slug
    return AID + "__" + suffix


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def xyz(value):
    return [value.x, value.y, value.z]


def body_vertices(actor):
    return [xyz(point) for point in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())]


def speed(vector):
    return math.sqrt(vector.x ** 2 + vector.y ** 2 + vector.z ** 2)


def check():
    return {"cases": [{"case_id": case_id(slug), "transfer_requested": CASES[slug]}
                      for slug in CASES],
            "camera_names": list(CAMERAS), "planned_frames": FRAMES,
            "rate_hz": RATE_HZ, "original_native_observed": False,
            "physical_transfer_confirmed": False,
            "zone_authority_confirmed": False}


def apply_controls(carla, scene, ego, passenger, tick):
    policy = scene["controller"]
    if tick < policy["halt_request_frame"]:
        current = speed(ego.get_velocity())
        error = scene["ego"]["target_speed_mps"] - current
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=max(0, min(.55, .2 * error)),
                                               brake=max(0, min(1, -.4 * error)), steer=0))
    elif tick < policy["resume_request_frame"]:
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1, steer=0,
                                               hand_brake=policy["action_request"] == "extended_park"))
    else:
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=.35, brake=0, steer=0))
    if policy["door_open_request_frame"] is not None and tick == policy["door_open_request_frame"]:
        ego.open_door(carla.VehicleDoor.FR)
    if policy["door_close_request_frame"] is not None and tick == policy["door_close_request_frame"]:
        ego.close_door(carla.VehicleDoor.FR)
    if scene["passenger"]["cross_doorway_requested"] and (
            policy["door_close_request_frame"] is not None and
            policy["passenger_walk_request_frame"] <= tick < policy["door_close_request_frame"]):
        target = scene["passenger"]["target_door_xyz"]
        position = passenger.get_location()
        dx, dy = target[0] - position.x, target[1] - position.y
        distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        direction = carla.Vector3D(dx / distance, dy / distance, 0) if distance > .05 else carla.Vector3D(0, 0, 0)
        passenger.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=direction, speed=1.0 if distance > .05 else 0))
    else:
        passenger.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=carla.Vector3D(0, 0, 0), speed=0))


def capture(slug, output, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as world_snapshot, restore as world_restore

    scene = request(slug)
    validate(scene)
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() and any((output / name).exists() for name in
                               ("video_frames.jsonl", "loading_motion.jsonl", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("retain prior Native attempt; choose a fresh output")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(120)
    prior = world_snapshot(client)
    encoders = {}
    core = None
    restored = None
    try:
        with constructed_scene(client, carla, scene) as actors:
            world = actors["world"]
            (output / "road.xodr").write_text(actors["map_opendrive"])
            sensors = {}
            for spec in scene["cameras"]:
                incoming = queue.Queue()
                actors["cameras"][spec["name"]].listen(incoming.put)
                sensors[spec["name"]] = incoming
                encoders[spec["name"]] = subprocess.Popen(
                    ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                     "-video_size", f"{spec['size'][0]}x{spec['size'][1]}", "-framerate", str(RATE_HZ),
                     "-i", "-", "-frames:v", str(FRAMES), "-c:v", "ffv1",
                     str(output / (spec["name"] + ".mkv"))], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            core = PipelineCapture(client, actors["ego"], output, case_id(slug),
                                   required_observations=[])
            first_elapsed = None
            civil_start = datetime.fromisoformat(scene["zone"]["civil_timestamp_start"])
            with (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as frame_file, \
                    (output / "loading_motion.jsonl").open("x") as motion_file, \
                    (output / "ego_body.jsonl").open("x") as body_file, \
                    (output / "passenger_body.jsonl").open("x") as passenger_file:
                for i in range(FRAMES):
                    apply_controls(carla, scene, actors["ego"], actors["passenger"], i)
                    native = world.tick()
                    snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
                    if snapshot.frame != native:
                        raise RuntimeError("original Native tick/snapshot mismatch")
                    if first_elapsed is None:
                        first_elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                    elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds - first_elapsed
                    if abs(elapsed - i / RATE_HZ) > .005:
                        raise RuntimeError("original 20 Hz frame join differs")
                    ego = actors["ego"]
                    passenger = actors["passenger"]
                    core.capture(native, elapsed, extra={"loading_source": {
                        "passenger_actor_id": passenger.id,
                        "passenger_position_m": xyz(passenger.get_location()),
                        "passenger_velocity_mps": xyz(passenger.get_velocity())}})
                    frames = {}
                    raw_hashes = {}
                    for name, incoming in sensors.items():
                        image = incoming.get(timeout=30)
                        if image.frame != native:
                            raise RuntimeError("original camera/Native frame mismatch: " + name)
                        frames[name] = image.frame
                        raw_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(image.raw_data).hexdigest()
                        encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    frame = {"video_frame": i, "native_frame": native,
                             "carla_frame": native, "time_s": elapsed,
                             "source_cameras": frames, "camera_rgb_sha256": raw_hashes}
                    frame_file.write(json.dumps(frame, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    body_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": ego.id,
                                                "body_vertices_m": body_vertices(ego)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    passenger_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": passenger.id,
                                                     "body_vertices_m": body_vertices(passenger)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    motion_file.write(json.dumps({**frame, "ego_actor_id": ego.id,
                        "passenger_actor_id": passenger.id,
                        "vehicle_speed_mps": speed(ego.get_velocity()),
                        "vehicle_center_m": xyz(ego.get_location()),
                        "passenger_center_m": xyz(passenger.get_location()),
                        "door_open_request_active": scene["controller"]["door_open_request_frame"] is not None and scene["controller"]["door_open_request_frame"] <= i < scene["controller"]["door_close_request_frame"],
                        "civil_timestamp": (civil_start + timedelta(seconds=i / RATE_HZ)).isoformat(),
                        "occupant_count_observed": False,
                        "actual_door_state_observed": False}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            for process in encoders.values():
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=120) != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("original source camera encoder failed")
            for name in CAMERAS:
                count = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                     "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
                     str(output / (name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
                if count != str(FRAMES):
                    raise ValueError("original source camera full decode differs: " + name)
            core.close(confirmed=True)
            core = None
            map_hash = sha(output / "road.xodr")
            write_json(output / "loading_zone.json", {
                "object_id": scene["zone"]["object_id"], "sign_id": scene["zone"]["sign_id"],
                "sign_text_hours": [scene["zone"]["hours_start"], scene["zone"]["hours_end"]],
                "time_zone": scene["zone"]["time_zone"], "map_readback_sha256": map_hash,
                "regulatory_authority_confirmed": False})
            sources = {"native_map": "road.xodr", "zone": "loading_zone.json",
                "motion": "loading_motion.jsonl", "ego_body": "ego_body.jsonl",
                "passenger_body": "passenger_body.jsonl", "camera_manifest": "video_frames.jsonl"}
            write_json(output / "loading_context.json", {
                "case_id": case_id(slug), "source_kind": "original_native_passenger_curb_readback",
                "source_files": sources,
                **{key + "_sha256": sha(output / filename) for key, filename in sources.items()},
                "requested_passenger_transfer": CASES[slug],
                "actual_passenger_transfer_confirmed": False,
                "occupant_count_observed": False,
                "regulatory_authority_confirmed": False,
                "expeditiousness_conclusion": None,
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        restored = world_restore(client, prior)
        write_json(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {
            "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "native_executed": True, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                     encoder_exit_codes={name: process.returncode for name, process in encoders.items()},
                     context={"case_id": case_id(slug), "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
                              "actual_passenger_transfer_confirmed": False})
        return {"case_id": case_id(slug), "source_frames": FRAMES,
                "original_capture_saved": True, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    except BaseException:
        if core is not None:
            core.close(confirmed=False)
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        if restored is None:
            world_restore(client, prior)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(), sort_keys=True))
    else:
        slug = args.case
        if slug not in CASES or not args.output_dir:
            parser.error("exact --case and --output-dir are required")
        print(json.dumps(capture(slug, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port), sort_keys=True))

"""Measured saved body, passenger and sign evidence without a legal verdict."""

from datetime import datetime
import math
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from .loading_scene import FRAMES, RATE_HZ


def sign_effective(timestamp, sign):
    if not sign.get("sign_id") or not sign.get("map_readback_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("original sign source missing")
    start, end = sign.get("sign_text_hours", [])
    def minutes(value):
        hour, minute = map(int, value.split(":"))
        if not (0 <= hour < 24 and 0 <= minute < 60):
            raise ValueError("invalid original sign hours")
        return 60 * hour + minute
    a, b = minutes(start), minutes(end)
    if a == b:
        raise ValueError("ambiguous original sign hours")
    instant = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)
    if instant.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("original civil timestamp lacks offset")
    local = instant.astimezone(ZoneInfo(sign["time_zone"]))
    clock = local.hour * 60 + local.minute
    return a <= clock < b if a < b else clock >= a or clock < b


def measure(context, sign, motion, ego_bodies, passenger_bodies, frames, trace):
    if not all(len(rows) == FRAMES for rows in
               (motion, ego_bodies, passenger_bodies, frames, trace)):

        raise ValueError("unsupported original passenger-transfer claim")

    zone_frames = []
    passenger_near_door_frames = []

            zip(motion, ego_bodies, passenger_bodies, frames, trace)):
        native = row.get("native_frame")
        if (row.get("video_frame") != i or frame.get("video_frame") != i or
                frame.get("native_frame") != native or core.get("frame") != native or
                body.get("native_frame") != native or passenger.get("native_frame") != native or
                body.get("actor_id") != row.get("ego_actor_id") or
                passenger.get("actor_id") != row.get("passenger_actor_id") or
                abs(row.get("time_s", -1) - i / RATE_HZ) > .005 or
                abs(frame.get("time_s", -2) - row.get("time_s", -3)) > 1e-6 or
                abs(core.get("time_s", -4) - row.get("time_s", -5)) > 1e-6):
            raise ValueError("original frame, actor or Core time join differs")
        if row.get("occupant_count_observed") is not False or row.get("actual_door_state_observed") is not False:
            raise ValueError("unreviewed occupant or door state was asserted")
        if len(body.get("body_vertices_m", [])) < 4 or len(passenger.get("body_vertices_m", [])) < 4:
            raise ValueError("original full body vertices missing")
        xs = [point[0] for point in body["body_vertices_m"]]
        if abs((min(xs) + max(xs)) / 2 - row["vehicle_center_m"][0]) > .05:
            raise ValueError("original vehicle body and motion differ")
        passenger_xyz = row.get("passenger_center_m", [])
        if len(passenger_xyz) != 3 or any(not math.isfinite(value) for value in passenger_xyz):
            raise ValueError("original passenger position missing")
        if not isinstance(row.get("vehicle_speed_mps"), (int, float)) or row["vehicle_speed_mps"] < 0:
            raise ValueError("original vehicle speed missing")
        in_zone = min(xs) >= zone_start and max(xs) <= zone_end
        halted = row["vehicle_speed_mps"] <= .05
        door_y = row["vehicle_center_m"][1] - 1.5
        near_door = abs(passenger_xyz[0] - row["vehicle_center_m"][0]) <= 2.5 and abs(passenger_xyz[1] - door_y) <= 1.0
        halted_frames.append(halted)
        zone_frames.append(in_zone)
        passenger_near_door_frames.append(near_door)
        effective_frames.append(sign_effective(row["civil_timestamp"], sign))
    return {"frames": FRAMES, "duration_s": FRAMES / RATE_HZ,
            "halted_in_marked_segment_frames": sum(h and z for h, z in zip(halted_frames, zone_frames)),
            "effective_sign_hours_frames": sum(effective_frames),

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from native.loading_scene import CAMERAS, FRAMES
from native.measure_loading_native import measure
from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result


def source(root, name):
    path = (root / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_zone_timing(observation):
    return {"halted_in_marked_segment_frames": observation["halted_in_marked_segment_frames"],
            "effective_sign_hours_frames": observation["effective_sign_hours_frames"],
            "zone_regulatory_authority": observation["zone_regulatory_authority"]}


def measure_passenger_context(observation):
    return {"passenger_near_door_frames": observation["passenger_near_door_frames"],
            "door_open_request_frames": observation["door_open_request_frames"],
            "observed_passenger_doorway_transfer": observation["observed_passenger_doorway_transfer"],
            "occupant_count": observation["occupant_count"],
            "expeditiousness": observation["expeditiousness"]}


def read_rows(root, name):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in source(root, name).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def inspect_sources(root, context):
    paths = context.get("source_files", {})
    required = {"native_map", "zone", "motion", "ego_body", "passenger_body", "camera_manifest"}
    if set(paths) != required:
        raise ValueError("Original passenger loading source inventory incomplete")
    for key, name in paths.items():
        if sha(source(root, name)) != context.get(key + "_sha256"):
            raise ValueError("Original passenger loading source hash differs: " + key)
    zone = json.loads(source(root, "loading_zone.json").read_text())
    if zone.get("map_readback_sha256") != context["native_map_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Original map/zone readback hash differs")
    if zone.get("regulatory_authority_confirmed") is not False:
        raise ValueError("Original regulatory authority was invented")
    return zone


def inspect_video_sources(root, frames):
    if len(frames) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Original four-camera frame map incomplete")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        count = subprocess.check_output(
            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
             "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
             str(source(root, name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
        if count != str(FRAMES):
            raise ValueError("Original source camera full decode differs: " + name)
    for row in frames:
        hashes = row.get("camera_rgb_sha256")
        if (not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != set(CAMERAS) or
                any(not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 for value in hashes.values())):
            raise ValueError("Original four-camera RGB frame hashes missing")
        if set(row.get("source_cameras", {})) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Original four-camera frame identities missing")
        if any(value != row.get("native_frame") for value in row["source_cameras"].values()):
            raise ValueError("Original four-camera Native frame join differs")


def finalize(attempt, output):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    destination = Path(output)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("Retain prior selected analysis output")
    config = json.loads(source(root, "config.json").read_text())
    case = config["selected_case_id"]
    context = json.loads(source(root, "loading_context.json").read_text())
    if case != context.get("case_id"):
        raise ValueError("Selected case and original loading context differ")
    kind = context.get("source_kind")
    if kind not in {"original_native_passenger_curb_readback", "synthetic_passenger_curb_fixture"}:
        raise ValueError("Known passenger curb source kind required")
    zone = inspect_sources(root, context)
    motion = read_rows(root, "loading_motion.jsonl")
    bodies = read_rows(root, "ego_body.jsonl")
    passengers = read_rows(root, "passenger_body.jsonl")
    frames = read_rows(root, "video_frames.jsonl")
    trace = read_rows(root, "trace.jsonl")
    inspect_video_sources(root, frames)
    measured = measure(context, zone, motion, bodies, passengers, frames, trace)
    provenance = json.loads(source(root, "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    expected_kind = "native" if kind == "original_native_passenger_curb_readback" else "synthetic_fixture"
    if (provenance.get("provenance_kind") != expected_kind or
            provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not (kind != "original_native_passenger_curb_readback")):
        raise ValueError("Passenger curb acquisition provenance differs")
    channels = root / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (channels / "vehicle_zone_motion.jsonl").write_text("".join(
        json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": {
            "vehicle_center_m": row["vehicle_center_m"],
            "vehicle_speed_mps": row["vehicle_speed_mps"],
            "door_open_request_active": row["door_open_request_active"]}},
            allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in motion))
    (channels / "passenger_body.jsonl").write_text("".join(
        json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": {
            "passenger_center_m": row["passenger_center_m"],
            "actor_id": row["passenger_actor_id"]}}, allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in motion))
    (channels / "zone_sign.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "zone_sign": zone, "source_sha256": sha(source(root, "loading_zone.json"))},
        allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    result = {"case_id": case, "measured_values": measured,
        "target_checks": [{"target": "source-bound passenger curb episode",
                           "requested": config.get("passenger_transfer_requested"),

                           "cause_evidence": ["loading_motion.jsonl", "ego_body.jsonl",
                                              "passenger_body.jsonl", "loading_zone.json",
                                              "video_frames.jsonl"]}],
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
        "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "600 saved frames measured; passenger transfer and legal review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": ["actual passenger transfer unconfirmed",
                                   "original zone regulatory authority unverified",
                                   "occupant count not observed by CARLA"],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in sorted(CAMERAS)],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": config["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": [
            {"name": "vehicle_zone_motion", "unit": "m,m/s", "reference": "channels/vehicle_zone_motion.jsonl"},
            {"name": "passenger_body", "unit": "m", "reference": "channels/passenger_body.jsonl"},
            {"name": "zone_sign", "unit": "structured", "reference": "channels/zone_sign.json"}],
        "realized_observables": {}, "provenance_kind": expected_kind,
        "diagnostic_fixture": kind != "original_native_passenger_curb_readback",
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
        "legal_verdict_claimed": False}

    write_result(root, result)
    sources = {name: sha(source(root, filename)) for name, filename in context["source_files"].items()}
    first_inputs = ["loading_zone.json", "loading_motion.jsonl", "ego_body.jsonl",
                    "passenger_body.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl"]
    shared_sources = {name: sha(source(root, name)) for name in first_inputs}
    payload = {"format": "worker-passenger-curb-selected-measurement", "case_id": case,
        "measurement": measured, "measurements": {
            "zone_timing": {"method": "measure_zone_timing",
                            "value": measure_zone_timing(measured), "sources": shared_sources},
            "passenger_context": {"method": "measure_passenger_context",
                                  "value": measure_passenger_context(measured),
                                  "sources": shared_sources}},
        "source_sha256": sources,
        "actual_passenger_transfer_confirmed": False,
        "zone_regulatory_authority_confirmed": False,
        "legal_compliance": "unassessed", "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return payload

    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
